Name: AI Farm Assistant
Author: Kimigakawaii
Description:
[b][size=5]FARM AI ASSISTANT (Do not use tokens, press space to open the HUD.)[/size][/b]

AI Farm Assistant is an automation tool in the game Stardew Valley. It provides a notebook-style HUD interface to manage Farm tasks, Utilities, Safety, Movement, and Schedules from a single location.

Automate repetitive tasks, move between key locations, protect players with safety rules, and prioritize daily tasks without leaving the game.
[heading][line]
[/heading]
[b][size=6]Feature[/size][/b]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Farm work[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Water Crops Automatic Irrigation System
Automatically waters nearby dry crops. Automatic watering can refill option available.[/*]
[*]Animal Care:
Livestock farming and milk or wool collection from cows, goats, and sheep when tools are needed.[/*]
[*]Automatic Harvester:
Harvests hand-picked crops, sickle-picked crops, and fodder crops.[/*]
[*]Planting & Fertilizing:
Sow seeds and fertilize from inventory; can use items without marked slots.[/*]
[*]Auto Fishing 2.0:
Automatically fishes in eligible waters. Supports fixed fishing spots in Town, Forest, Beach, and Mountain.[/*]
[*]Automatic Mining Mode:
Mines nearby rocks, ore, and gems. Includes ladder priority and an option to automatically fight nearby monsters.[/*]
[*]Automatic Chopping:
Chops oak, maple, and pine trees.[/*]
[*]Debris Clearing:
Removes rocks, wood, and weeds.[/*]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Utility tools[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Put items in the nearest chest.[/*]
[*]Automate the machinery.[/*]
[*]Collect and refill the crab cages.[/*]
[*]Open the gates and cage doors.[/*]
[*]Arrange items between the chests.[/*]
[*]Transfer selected items to the transport container.[/*]
[/list][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Safety & Recovery[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]The auto-feeding mode activates when Health or Energy reaches 40%.[/*]
[*]The Inventory Recovery function will store items when the inventory is full, then resume interrupted tasks.[/*]
[*]The Auto-Return Home function will stop lower-priority tasks and return the player to home.[/*]
[/list][color=#1155cc][size=4][b]Movement[/b][/size][/color]

Automatically navigate between Farm, Town, Forest, Beach, and Mountain.
Travel to Island and Desert will use the corresponding Teleportation Pillar when available. Walking to Farm will stop at the farmhouse entrance.

[color=#fce5cd][size=4][b]Schedule[/b][/size][/color]
Create task lists from Farm, Utility, and Transportation activities.

[list]
[*]Tasks are performed from top to bottom.[/*]
[*]Rearrange, delete, pause, or restart tasks.[/*]
[*]Select tasks to complete based on results or tasks to complete based on time.[/*]
[*]Set start and end times.[/*]
[*]Automatically skip tasks after 2 seconds if there are no valid tasks.[/*]
[*]Display current and upcoming scheduled tasks in a compact HUD while running.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]HUD and Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The in-game HUD interface is notebook-style.[/*]
[*]Five groups: Farm, Utility, Safety, Transportation, and Schedule.[/*]
[*]Displays live status of inventory space, health, energy, player location, and current tile.[/*]
[*]Up to three Farm Notes.[/*]
[/list]You can access individual farm settings via the gear icon for each feature.
[heading]AI Farm Assistant 1.1.0[/heading]
[list]
[*]New notebook-style HUD with Farm, Utility, Safety, Movement, Schedule, and Co-op groups.[/*]
[*]Added Farm Notes, health/energy, free slots, location, and current-task display.[/*]
[*]Improved Farm automation: watering, animal care, harvesting, planting, mining, hoeing, chopping, debris cleanup, and fishing.[/*]
[*]Added temporary work-area selection using two right-clicks.[/*]
[*]Added saved fishing spots and improved Auto Fishing behavior.[/*]
[*]Expanded Safety: Auto Eat, inventory recovery, return home, auto loot, and emergency stop.[/*]
[*]Added Movement routes, saved destinations, Farm/Leave House travel, Island and Desert support.[/*]
[*]Added Schedule save/load, task timing, pause/restart, and Monthly Schedule assignment.[/*]
[*]Added X button to remove a schedule from an individual calendar day.[/*]
[*]Added multiplayer Remote Assistant controls and Follow Requester.[/*]
[*]HUD buttons and hitboxes now scale correctly with HUD size.[/*]
[*]Automatic manual movement now uses two right-clicks on the same tile.[/*]
[*]Improved animation timing, task recovery, background automation, and stability.[/*]
[/list][heading][line]
[/heading]
[size=6][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 is recommended for configuration support.[/*]
[*]Keep the included section.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][code]assets[/code]The folder inside the mod folder.[/*]
[/list]Install SMAPI.Download and extract.
